_comment: P-51 Mustang. The propeller node is spelled 'propeler' in the file; that is the file's spelling, not a typo here. Control surfaces are regions of the aeroplane: a span band as a fraction of the half span, a height band as a fraction of the half height, everything aft of `aft_of` along the length, and a hinge at that fraction of the LOCAL chord in the region. A downloaded airframe is one solid mesh and has no hinges of its own, so they are cut out of it.
